items.name: bl-ui
items.title: BL UI
items.description: Installs @brett_lamy/ui, imports its stylesheet, and registers BL UI's extra color utilities (text-tertiary-foreground, bg-secondary-strong, bg-bar, text-success, …) next to shadcn's.

theme.font-ios: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

items.docs: BL UI colors are your shadcn theme variables. For the iOS look add the bl-theme item (npx shadcn add …/r/bl-theme.json). With Vite, pre-bundle the Markdown engine (it ships TypeScript source): optimizeDeps: { include: ["@brett_lamy/ui > @brett_lamy/docstream", "@brett_lamy/ui > @brett_lamy/docstream-editor"] }.

items.name: bl-theme
items.title: BL theme
items.description: BL UI's iOS look as a shadcn theme: sets your CSS variables (light and dark) to the iOS palette, plus the Workbench, terminal and chat theme scopes.

items.name: adaptive-pane
items.title: AdaptivePane
items.description: One pane presented as a column, sheet or pushed page depending on the room it has.

items.name: artifact-chat-container
items.title: ArtifactChatContainer
items.description: Chat docked beside an artifact when wide; a floating glass Composer over the artifact when narrow.

items.name: chat-shell
items.title: ChatShell
items.description: A team-chat scaffold: an optional workspace rail and channel sidebar beside the conversation, one drawer when narrow.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: CommandMenu
items.description: A cmdk-style command palette on react-aria: nested pages, fuzzy ranking with highlight, grid groups, ⌘1–9 and a keyboard legend.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The Workbench prompt box as parts: card, Docstream editor, footer pills, draggable bumps, compact and FAB collapse.

items.name: credenza
items.title: Credenza
items.description: A dialog on wide screens and a draggable tray on phones, from one composition.

items.name: edge-drawer
items.title: EdgeDrawer
items.description: A drawer that follows the finger from any edge, with rubber-banding and velocity-aware snapping.

items.name: floating-sheet
items.title: FloatingSheet
items.description: A floating card that grows into the full page along one drag, over a map or canvas.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icons
items.description: An SF Symbols-style icon set on a 24px grid: round-capped strokes in six weights, filled variants, and custom shapes.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Inset-grouped and plain lists with rows, sections, swipe actions and an A-Z IndexBar.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: MarkdownEditor
items.description: A themed WYSIWYG Markdown editor over docstream-editor: slash menu, Markdown paste, inline or chip images, toolbar.

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: MarkdownView
items.description: Docstream-rendered GitBook-flavored Markdown: headings, hints, tables, tabs, highlighted code.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: MessageScroller
items.description: A chat transcript scroller anchored to the newest message, with streaming-aware autoscroll.

items.name: morph
items.title: Morph
items.description: Shared-element transitions: one element springs between two layouts (mini player → full player), drag-to-dismiss friendly, reduced-motion aware.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: Springs and the motion vocabulary: TextMorph, NumberMorph, IconSwap, Chevron, AnimatedHeight, ContentSwap, Celebrate.

items.name: navigation-stack
items.title: NavigationStack
items.description: A controlled push/pop stack with large titles and edge-swipe back.

items.name: now-playing-bars
items.title: NowPlayingBars
items.description: The animated equaliser beside the track that's playing — still when paused and under reduced motion — plus the Slider tones for media controls.

items.name: pencilkit
items.title: PencilKit
items.description: Pressure-aware drawing (perfect-freehand) with the PencilKit tool picker, and the Composer image annotator.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: ProgressRing
items.description: Circular progress: a determinate ring that springs to each value with a rolling percentage, and a CountdownRing that drains second by second and turns red near the end.

items.name: replay-preview
items.title: ReplayPreview
items.description: An rrweb session replay in a browser frame: a URL bar that follows the recording, play/pause, a scrubber with click, error, failed-request and navigation markers, speed, fullscreen, a drawn cursor with click ripples, and a skeleton poster while the player loads.

items.name: side-drawer
items.title: SideDrawer
items.description: An inspector column: docked beside the content, or an overlay sheet with a scrim.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Docked, rail, floating or overlay navigation with workspace, search, sections and items.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders with a soft left-to-right sweep instead of a pulse: text lines, circles, rects and rounded blocks, and a SkeletonText paragraph with a shorter last line.

items.name: split-view
items.title: SplitView
items.description: An adaptive sidebar / supplementary / detail split that collapses by its own measured width.

items.name: syntax-highlighting
items.title: SyntaxHighlighting
items.description: Code highlighted on the GPU by gpu-lexer: file header, copy button, line numbers, highlighted and diff lines, inline code.

items.name: tab-view
items.title: TabView
items.description: Tabs as parts: a bar at any edge, sliding indicator, directional panels, swipe between panels.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: BLProvider, ThemeScope and the appearance context: pick light/dark, a tint and a theme scope for a subtree. Colors are shadcn variables (see the bl-theme item for the iOS palette).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: HUDs and banners on react-aria's toast region: the "Copied" pill that updates in place, stacking banners with actions, springs, auto-dismiss and announcements.

items.name: workbench-shell
items.title: WorkbenchShell
items.description: An IDE scaffold that owns the width class and region visibility; compose regions into its slots.

items.name: alfred-clone
items.title: Alfred
items.description: A macOS Alfred-style launcher on the CommandMenu primitive, floating over a desktop with a menu bar and dock. Its features are nested pages, each with its own keys: a calculator with live results and history (type math at the root and the answer shows inline), clipboard history with a preview pane, pinning (⌘P) and delete (⌘⌫), an emoji grid you move through with the arrow keys, snippets that expand from ;keywords, file search with folders you open with → and reveal with ⌘↵, system commands (lock screen, sleep, empty Trash with a confirmation, dark mode, restart), web searches, and multi-step workflows (create a GitHub issue, start a timer). ⌥Space hides and shows the bar, and a HUD confirms each copy. Adapts to its container's width; light and dark.

items.name: apple-mail
items.title: Apple Mail clone
items.description: Apple Mail: Favorites, Smart Mailboxes and iCloud sections with rolling unread counts; a message list with unread dots, flags, attachments, previews and relative times; swipe actions (ListRow), edit mode, search and an unread filter; a message view with a quoted thread and reply, flag, move, archive and trash; and a compose sheet. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop, an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, SheetContent, MarkdownEditor and DropdownMenu.

items.name: apple-music
items.title: Apple Music
items.description: Apple Music: Listen Now, Browse, Radio, Search and a Library (Recently Added, Artists, Albums, Songs, playlists) with generated album artwork, album, artist and playlist pages that tint from their artwork, and a mini player that springs open into the full Now Playing screen — scrubber, transport, volume, lyrics and up next — as one morphing element. A SplitView sidebar on desktop and tablet; the iOS tab bar with the mini player above it on phones; light and dark.

items.name: apple-notes
items.title: Apple Notes clone
items.description: Apple Notes: iCloud and On My Mac folders with All iCloud, Recently Deleted and tags; notes grouped Pinned · Today · Previous 7 Days… with snippets, or a gallery of thumbnails; a Markdown note editor with checklists and tables; pin, lock, share, move, delete, search, swipe actions (ListRow) and new notes that spring into place. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop (the list steps aside for the gallery), an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles, supplementaryVisible), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, MarkdownEditor (classNames), Segmented and DropdownMenu.

items.name: apple-passwords
items.title: Apple Passwords
items.description: Apple's Passwords app: category tiles with counts (All, Passkeys, Codes, Wi-Fi, Security, Deleted) and shared groups, a searchable item list, and a detail with copy buttons, a password that morphs into view, verification codes with a countdown ring, a “Copied” HUD, edit mode, security recommendations by severity, and Wi-Fi networks with a QR code. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, a pushed stack on phones; light and dark.

items.name: apple-reminders
items.title: Apple Reminders
items.description: Apple Reminders: smart-list tiles (Today, Scheduled, All, Flagged, Completed) with live counts, colored lists with sections, circular checkboxes that spring filled, inline add, a details sheet (notes, date and time, flag, priority, subtasks), show/clear completed, search, and a small burst when a list is cleared. Sidebar and list side by side on wide screens; the lists screen pushes the list on phones. Large list titles fold into the bar as you scroll; tints with each list's color, light and dark.

items.name: apple-settings
items.title: Apple Settings
items.description: iOS, iPadOS and macOS Settings in one block: search, an Apple Account header, inset groups with colored icon tiles, and drill-down panes with switches, sliders, pickers and segmented controls. One SplitView: macOS System Settings at desktop, an iPad split on tablets, and on phones the large-title list with panes pushing over it. Display & Brightness switches light and dark live.

items.name: discord-clone
items.title: Discord clone
items.description: A team chat in Discord's shape: server rail, channel sidebar with threads, a transcript with reactions and thread previews, a member list, and a thread panel that docks on wide screens and slides over on narrow ones. Composed from ChatShell and TabView, with its own channel, message, member and composer parts.

items.name: github-clone
items.title: GitHub clone
items.description: A GitHub repository page: file browser with README and code viewer, issue and pull request lists with labels, a pull request conversation with review timeline, merge box and comment composer, a unified diff for Files changed, and Actions runs. Primer colors in light and dark; collapses to a phone layout with pushed screens.

items.name: loop-qa
items.title: Loop QA
items.description: An agentic QA workspace after Loop QA / Replay QA. Projects (a URL under test) with drawn site thumbnails, bug trends and live-run state; per project an Overview (tiles, the live run, an exploration replay carousel, latest findings), a filterable Bugs table (severity, status, kind, environment; copy, download and connect an issue tracker), a Site map tree with coverage, Test runs and generated Playwright tests with highlighted source. A bug opens to its session replay (ReplayPreview: scrubber markers for the failed request and the error, a drawn cursor with click ripples), network and console logs that seek the replay, expected vs actual, a chronology whose evidence frames are the replay frozen at each step, and the root cause; a run to its findings, coverage, exploration and journeys. The Ask QA agent is an ArtifactChatContainer around the app (the page is the artifact): a trailing column on a desktop, a floating composer over the page on a tablet or phone with the transcript on its draggable bump (the newest reply peeking on a tablet), folded into a FAB when hidden; tool calls in a work log, streamed Markdown answers, and runs that report live in a card. ⌘K jumps to any project, bug or run and runs commands (start a run, copy reports, change a bug's status or severity, connect a tracker, switch the theme) across nested pages with a bug preview pane. One SplitView at every size — tiled on a desktop, a floating sidebar on a tablet, a stack on a phone; light and dark.

items.name: t3-clone
items.title: T3 Code clone
items.description: An IDE-style agent workspace in the style of T3 Code: thread sidebar, streaming conversation with a composer that flies from centre to dock, resizable terminal dock, a surface panel (browser, terminal, files, diff, agents), and a ⌘K command palette with nested pages (new thread in a project, link pull requests, go to file, search contents, add a project from a local folder, Git URL or GitHub) plus a live theme editor. Docks everything on desktop, slides the panel in as a drawer on tablets, and moves to a hamburger sidebar, bottom tab bar and snap-sheet terminal on phones. Composed from the WorkbenchShell, conversation, terminal and surface primitives, with its own thread sidebar parts.
